name: USDtb (Ethena Labs)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A single bare EOA - a real, actively-used key, not vanity-mined - holds both DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and the ProxyAdmin owner() on a $483M stablecoin. No Safe, no Timelock, no DAO anywhere.
narrative.detail: The same EOA also independently holds admin on two other proxies (fUSD, aBTC) with negligible real usage, so those aren’t scored as their own targets - but the blast radius is real. Genuinely inconsistent within Ethena’s own infrastructure: USDtb’s own PSM (next card) migrated from a Safe to a real 24h Timelock on 2026-07-13; this token’s upgrade authority never got the same treatment.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (13 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xc139190f447e929f090edeb554d95abb8b18ac1c","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","0x18f5995"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x18f5995"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xc139190f447e929f090edeb554d95abb8b18ac1c","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (13 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x18f5995"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 26171796 and 26171797 of the chain

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 13 transactions sent; delay: none
